nodes.label: Config Dialog Example Screenshot
nodes.rationale: Screenshot of a live Config Demo window showing every supported plugin-config widget in one dark modal, so authors can copy the layout rather than infer it from code.

nodes.label: Two-Column Settings Layout
nodes.rationale: Each row keeps a left-aligned label and a right-aligned widget so mixed control types share one vertical rhythm.

nodes.label: Config Widget Catalog
nodes.rationale: The demo packs toggle, integer, float, text, dropdown, color, color-with-alpha, keybind, and button into one window so the supported control set is visible at a glance.

nodes.label: Copy.hlsl
nodes.rationale: Do not CopyResource UNORM UAV color onto an *_SRGB backbuffer — that double-encodes and crushes midtones.

nodes.label: Velocity Convention 15
nodes.rationale: Required convention is exactly 15: unjittered, pixel units, Y down, current-to-previous. previousPixel = currentPixel + motion. FrameGen scale is (+1,+1).

nodes.label: VelocityProbe
nodes.rationale: VelocityProbe must be readable and Off. Missing probe metadata fails closed. The catalog cannot certify conventions and is no longer a velocity fallback.

nodes.label: Assets Folder Unused
nodes.rationale: This folder is unused. FrameGen ships as C# only: interpolator and motion-vector DXBC are baked into ShaderBytecode.cs. There is no custom native DLL.

nodes.label: Anomaly Owns Shared Rendering Gaps
nodes.rationale: When this pack invents lighting, IsolatedMix energy, or march LOD that the next Anomaly shader will also need, file it on Anomaly Docs/Extensibility.md Slice AI and wiki/Framework-gaps.md.

nodes.label: Rich HUD Config Save Rule
nodes.rationale: Rich HUD sliders must not serialize or write config on every tick.

nodes.label: HUD Sprites Are Not Warped
nodes.rationale: HUD sprites are not warped. PostPP Rich HUD is skipped in Keen's pass so the terminal is not alpha-blended twice, frozen in layout view space, and drawn once onto each presented frame.

nodes.label: No Half-Frame Spin Wait
nodes.rationale: The render thread does not spin-wait a half frame because that path halves game FPS and flashes the interpolant before the real frame.

nodes.label: FrameGen Is Not An Upscaler
nodes.rationale: FrameGen does not call ClaimUpscale or NotifyUpscaleComplete; AfterUpscale Display tenants keep the slot. It will not claim Anomaly AfterUpscale.

nodes.label: VSync Off Requirement
nodes.rationale: An extra Present with VSync on waits a full refresh, so generated frames do not raise displayed FPS.
